nodes.description: Public mapping (address => Holder) Acc storing each holder's unlockTime and balance.
Log LogFile reference set in the constructor and used by Put/Collect to record messages.
Public uint MinSum = 1 ether, the minimum balance required to Collect.
Public Message[] History array in Log contract, appended to by AddMessage.
Storage struct LastMsg reused as a temporary buffer before pushing into History.
Public payable Put(uint _unlockTime) that credits msg.value to the caller's Holder and sets its unlock time.
Public payable Collect(uint _am) that checks balance/MinSum/unlockTime then performs an unchecked external call before debiting the balance.
Payable fallback function that forwards to Put(0), allowing deposits without an explicit Put call.
PIG_BANK(address log) constructor assigning the external Log contract address to LogFile.
Public AddMessage(address _adr,uint _val,string _data) in Log that writes LastMsg and pushes it into History.
Caller-controlled address used as the account key in Acc and as the destination of the value transfer.
now / block.timestamp used as the unlock-time fallback in Put and as the maturity check in Collect.
Low-level external CALL forwarding _am wei to msg.sender before the balance is decremented, enabling reentrancy.
Caller-supplied unlock time for the holder account.
Caller-supplied amount to withdraw and to forward in the external call.
Address of the Log contract supplied at deployment.
Storage reference to Acc[msg.sender] used to credit balance and set unlockTime in Put.
Storage reference to Acc[msg.sender] read for the guards and debited after the external call in Collect.
Sender address recorded into LastMsg.Sender.
Value recorded into LastMsg.Val.
Message tag recorded into LastMsg.Data.

edges.reason: _unlockTime parameter is consumed by Put to compute the holder unlock time.
Put uses now (block.timestamp) as the lower bound of the unlock time, making the lock duration miner-influenceable.
msg.sender selects which Holder entry in Acc is credited by Put.
Put creates the local storage reference acc = Acc[msg.sender].
The local acc reference writes balance and unlockTime into the Acc mapping.
Put mutates persistent holder accounting in Acc.
Put reports the deposit through LogFile.AddMessage.
The payable fallback forwards execution to Put(0), so every plain transfer is a deposit.
_am parameter is used for the withdrawal guard and the debit amount in Collect.
Collect gates the withdrawal on now > acc.unlockTime, a timestamp dependency.
msg.sender determines the account whose funds Collect releases and is the call target.
Collect reads MinSum to enforce the minimum balance requirement.
Collect creates the local storage reference acc = Acc[msg.sender].
The local acc reference reads balance/unlockTime and writes the reduced balance in Acc.
_am is subtracted from acc.balance after a successful withdrawal.
Collect performs the low-level external call to msg.sender while state has not yet been updated.
_am is the wei amount forwarded by the external call, tying the attacker-controlled argument to the vulnerable transfer.
The external call re-enters Collect before acc.balance is decremented, allowing repeated withdrawals.
The external call can re-enter the fallback (classic DAO-style attack), which re-deposits via Put and re-triggers Collect.
Collect logs the successful withdrawal through LogFile.AddMessage.
The log address parameter is used by the constructor to initialise LogFile.
The constructor writes the Log contract reference into LogFile.
_adr parameter is stored into LastMsg.Sender by AddMessage.
_val parameter is stored into LastMsg.Val by AddMessage.
_data parameter is stored into LastMsg.Data by AddMessage.
AddMessage writes the reused storage struct LastMsg.
AddMessage pushes LastMsg into the History array.
AddMessage stamps LastMsg.Time with now (block.timestamp), a timestamp-derived log field.

normalization_plan.reason: _unlockTime is a call-scoped parameter whose only use is computing the unlock time inside Put.
_am is a call-scoped parameter consumed by the balance guard and the external value transfer in Collect.
log is a deployment-scoped parameter used only to assign LogFile in the constructor.
acc is a function-local storage pointer to Acc[msg.sender] created and mutated only within Put.
acc is the local storage pointer read by the guards and debited after the unsafe external call in Collect.
_adr is a call-scoped parameter stored into LastMsg.Sender.
_val is a call-scoped parameter stored into LastMsg.Val.
_data is a call-scoped parameter stored into LastMsg.Data.
